messages:
Maya (PM): kicking off a thread to land a phased onboarding + engagement SLA for design partners. Goal: run a 6-week beta with staggered waves. Need: commit tiers, feedback cadence, pass/fail gates, and concrete success metrics. thoughts?

Joel (Eng): +1. We should be explicit about measurable success criteria: weekly API qps, 95p latency target, eval-regression threshold (e.g. <5% on core prompts), and a qualitative CS satisfaction score. Also define what counts as a blocker.

Anika (Design): We should require one 60-min weekly sync (video) for wave A, then drop to biweekly in wave B. Add asynchronous checkpoints: 3 short NPS-style surveys (week 1, week 3, week 6). For feedback artifacts, ask partners to fill a short prompt catalog: 10 core prompts + 5 edge cases.

Ravi (CS): Support/SLA proposal: 24h response on weekdays, 48h on weekends for non-critical; phone escalation for sev-1. Partners must sign DP agreement + consent to ephemeral logs for 30 days. Also recommend a sample-data redaction checklist.

Maya (PM): Drafting commit tiers to incentivize engagement:
- Bronze: minimal participation (1 session/month + surveys) -> access to baseline support only
- Silver: active (3 sessions/month + surveys + prompt catalog) -> priority triage, $X credit
- Gold: full engagement (weekly sessions + eval runs) -> priority fixes, $Y credit + rollout influence
These tiers tie to compensation and SLA priority. Thoughts on thresholds?

Joel (Eng): For rollout: propose Wave A (2 partners) = 1-week smoke + integration checks; Wave B (4 partners) = full 6-week program. If regressions on eval set >5% or latency 95p > target for 2 consecutive days we pause and rollback. Need telemetry hooks: per-route latency, per-model token cost, error-rate by prompt class.

Maya (PM): I drafted a short invite + consent blurb and a signup form (mock): https://forms.gle/abc123. Copy below: 
```
Subject: Redwood DP invite — phased beta (6 weeks)
Hi {name},
Thanks for agreeing to preview our inference platform. Wave A is a 1-week smoke + 6-week beta. We ask for weekly check-ins, a short prompt catalog, and permission to collect ephemeral logs for debugging (30d). Compensation: tier-based credits + priority support.
Accept: [Yes link]
Decline: [No link]
```

Anika (Design): I'll build a Notion checklist with onboarding steps, UI walkthroughs, and prompt templates so partners can start with reproducible seeds. Can we include a sample evaluation harness (10 examples + scoring rubric)?

Maya (PM): yes pls. Also thinking of runbooks for common partner issues (model mismatch, token cost spikes, auth errors).

calendar-bot: Created event 'DP Wave A kickoff' scheduled for 2056790000.

Ravi (CS): SLA draft uploaded to internal doc: https://redwood/notion/sla (mock). I included escalation matrix and phone number placeholder.

Maya (PM): Next steps / owners:
- Maya: finalize invite + send to wave A candidates (target send ts 2056790500)
- Joel: telemetry & dashboard templates for per-route metrics
- Anika: Notion onboarding + evaluation harness
- Ravi: finalize SLA + onboarding checklist items related to compliance

Maya (PM): target: run wave A for 1 week as smoke, evaluate gates, then decide go/no-go for wave B. I'll post a short scoring rubric for pass/fail by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Joel (Eng): I'll stub the dashboard and add alert thresholds. Will ping when ready.

Anika (Design): will share checklist link in this thread when done.

Ravi (CS): I'll prep the partner-facing support doc (how to file a bug, data redaction steps).

Maya (PM): thanks team — keeping this lightweight to move fast. If anyone wants to change the tiers or cadence, flag here.
